info.title: Workeasy Forms API
info.description: Routes implemented through GOV-01. Organization routes derive the tenant from the authenticated membership; resources outside the caller's organizations return 404. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header, and every error is application/problem+json with the same requestId.

get.description: Anyone-with-the-link forms: Cache-Control public, max-age=30. Organization-only forms need the respondent sign-in and are private, no-store. Unknown, draft, archived and deleted forms are all 404.

post.summary: Start a respondent session pinned to the live version (respondent origin only)
post.description: Organization-only forms need a respondent sign-in and an active membership. The capability is returned once; only its hash is stored. Sessions last two hours and keep their version even if a newer one is published.

post.description: Carries no body and no answers; recorded once per session.

get.summary: Whether this session may submit right now (never cached)
get.description: Reads the current form state and access policy, so closing a form or revoking a member takes effect immediately.

200.description: Accepting, with the session's pinned version

401.description: SESSION_INVALID: missing, forged, expired or another session's capability

403.description: NOT_A_MEMBER: the respondent no longer has access

404.description: The form is no longer available

post.summary: Submit the session's answers (intake transaction)
post.description: The response, its idempotency record, the session's accepted marker and a submission.accepted.v1 event commit together, after the form's state and the respondent's access are rechecked under a lock and the answers pass the server engine. A session accepts one response. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key and content returns the recorded receipt (Idempotent-Replayed: true); a later request under another key gets the first receipt (Submission-Already-Accepted: true). Answers are never echoed back.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8 to 200 visible ASCII characters; reuse it when retrying the same answers

201.description: Accepted (or a replay of the same request, with Idempotent-Replayed: true)

403.description: NOT_A_MEMBER: the respondent no longer has access

404.description: The form is no longer available

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (same key, different answers), VERSION_MISMATCH (not the session's version) or FORM_NOT_OPEN

410.description: FORM_CLOSED, or FORM_FULL when the response limit is reached (checked atomically with other submissions)

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: field errors from the engine, as answers.<fieldId>, including FILE_PENDING, FILE_INFECTED, FILE_REJECTED, FILE_EXPIRED and FILE_NOT_FOUND for attachments

429.description: RESPONSE_QUOTA_REACHED: the organization's monthly quota is used up; Retry-After says when it resets

post.description: The field must be a file field of the session's version, the type one it allows and the size within its limit. The URL accepts exactly that type and size for five minutes. Files are scanned before they can be submitted.

post.summary: Ask AI for a proposal for this draft (requires forms.edit)
post.description: Queues a generation against the given draft revision. The worker asks the configured provider, then parses and validates the reply exactly like a draft being published, with one repair attempt; the result is a validated proposal or a failure code. The draft is never changed. Limits: prompt up to 8000 characters, one active generation per user and five per organization, a 120-second deadline. The prompt is not returned, logged or audited.

get.summary: Views, starts and accepts per UTC day (requires analytics.read)
get.description: Aggregated from respondent sessions only; no answers are read and nothing identifies a respondent. view: a session was opened; start: its respondent first changed an answer; accept: its response was accepted (later deletion does not change the count). Each is counted once per session, on the UTC day the session was opened. Up to 366 days; the definitions are returned with the data.

post.summary: Add an email notification, a signed webhook, or a confirmation email to respondents
post.description: Each accepted response is then delivered once per enabled integration, with retries at about 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 8h and 24h, and a history of every attempt. Webhook URLs must be HTTPS on port 443 or 8443 and resolve only to public addresses, checked now and before every delivery; redirects are not followed. Webhook payloads hold identifiers and only the chosen fields, which the requester must be allowed to read; requests are signed with HMAC-SHA256 (Workeasy-Signature over "<Workeasy-Timestamp>.<body>"), and receivers should reject timestamps older than five minutes and deduplicate on Workeasy-Event-Id. The signing secret is returned once. Emails go to fixed recipients and carry a link, never answers. A confirmation sends the owners' plain-text subject and message to the address the respondent gave in the chosen email question, at most 5 times per address per day across the organization and 500 times per hour per confirmation; others are recorded as skipped. Audited.
